items.title: 12.4 Nitrogen ke oxides ke zaraye (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 12.4 heading, printed page 277.

blocks.text: NOx ke zaraye do bari qismon mein bat-te hain, qudrati (12.4.1) aur anthropogenic yani insani (12.4.2).

blocks.prompt: Petrol engine mein nitrogen oxides kyun bante hain jabke petrol mein nitrogen nahi hoti?
blocks.explanation: Engine mein kheenchi gai hawa ka chaar-panjwan hissa nitrogen hai; jalne ke zyada darja hararat par us ka kuch hissa oxygen se react karta hai, N2 + O2 se 2NO, jo phir exhaust aur hawa mein NO2 mein oxidise hota hai.

items: NOx ke zaraye: qudrati aur anthropogenic.
